mapper.select: SELECT /* getReplyList */ R.REPT_NUMB , R.REPL_NUMB , R.UPER_NUMB , IF(R.UPER_NUMB IS NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS PARENT_YN , R.USER_NUMB , CASE WHEN R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS MY_REPLY_YN , R.REPL_CNTN , R.DELT_YSNO , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_DATE , IF(R.UPDT_DATE IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS UPDT_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UPDT_YSNO', IF(R.UPDT_DATE IS NULL, 'N', 'Y'), NULL) AS UPDT_YSNO_NM , U.USER_NICK , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH FROM TB_REPLXX R LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON R.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_REPLXX P ON P.REPT_NUMB = R.REPT_NUMB AND P.REPL_NUMB = R.UPER_NUMB WHERE R.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} ORDER BY COALESCE(P.REGI_DATE, R.REGI_DATE) DESC , COALESCE(P.REPL_NUMB, R.REPL_NUMB) DESC , CASE WHEN R.UPER_NUMB IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC , R.REGI_DATE DESC , R.REPL_NUMB DESC
SELECT /* getReplyReportUserNumb */ USER_NUMB FROM TM_REPORT WHERE REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb}
